title: M5GFX #437: add arduino-esp32 3.3.13 and 4.0.0 to the Arduino CI matrix (CI build verification)

execution.environment: GitHub Actions ubuntu-latest with arduino-cli 1.1.1 (PR CI run 44725782321); macOS arm64 host used only for read-only evidence collection and metadata comparison; no local rebuild

checks.detail: 1 file, +43/-2 in .github/workflows/ArduinoBuild.yml; matrix 11 -> 21 rows, exactly 10 rows added and none removed; no duplicate (board, version) pair; head 6be660c single commit on develop 44324f3; MERGEABLE/clean; patch applies to base

package_esp32_index.json lists 4.0.0 then 3.3.13 as newest platforms; release titles say 4.0.0 is based on ESP-IDF v6.1.1 (published 2026-11-19) and 3.3.13 on v5.5.6+ (2026-11-17), matching the PR body

boards.txt tag 3.3.13 defaults esp32p4.build.chip_variant=esp32p4_es (pre-v3) and tag 4.0.0 defaults to esp32p4 (v3+); both tags define menu.ChipVariant.prev3 and postv3, so the FQBN options used by the PR are valid; platform.txt selects the prebuilt SDK via {build.chip_variant} and sets -DF_CPU from the menu, so the two P4 rows per release select different chip revisions
P4 jobs on the same release produce different sketch sizes (3.3.13 default 450064 vs postv3 451408 bytes; 4.0.0 default 465474 vs prev3 468436 bytes), so the ChipVariant rows are not duplicate builds
Arduino Build run 44725782321 on head 6be660c: 21/21 jobs success; all 10 new jobs pass in 69-107 s; 38/38 check runs on the commit succeed

M5Unified develop CI covers 3.0.7 / 3.2.1 / 3.3.12 plus the M5Stack package and clones M5GFX at the PR base branch (master only for master, otherwise develop), so M5GFX PRs are indeed not built on 3.0 / 3.2; the new matrix comment matches both workflows
non-blocking: the 'built by both CIs' statement only holds once M5Unified PR #445 (3.3.12 -> 3.3.13 plus the 4.0.0 rows) merges; until then M5Unified still builds 3.3.12

not run locally: arduino-cli is not installed on the review host and the 3.3.13 / 4.0.0 platform packages were not downloaded, so conclusions rely on the upstream Actions run plus public metadata quoted in evidence/
not applicable: the change only adds CI build rows and does not alter runtime behavior
structurally not applicable: a CI matrix change produces no firmware behavior difference, so no virtual device model can observe anything; the only observable is build success
booting on pre-v3 and v3+ P4 silicon was not exercised; the PR only claims the rows compile

notes: PR left OPEN; one English comment posted; no close, no push, no change to m5stack/M5GFX.
No m5agent comment or review existed before this review.
